note: Each entry carries its provenance. S means located through search results this session and not yet re-read at the primary page; re-verify before relying on status or version. The DSA Standards Catalogue page was last updated 25 October 2023 when checked.

standards.name: UK Cross-Government Metadata Exchange Model (xGov MEM)
standards.purpose: A common model for describing datasets, data services and distributions so catalogues across government can exchange metadata.
standards.status: Endorsed for implementation by the Data Standards Authority Steering Board
standards.evidence: Model content verified: vendored from co-cddo/ukgov-metadata-exchange-model at commit d6d9a24. Endorsement wording is from the published model page as recorded by the owner; page not re-read this session.

standards.name: Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT)
standards.purpose: W3C vocabulary for describing datasets and data services in catalogues; the base vocabulary xGov MEM builds on.
standards.evidence: xGov MEM classes map to dcat:Dataset, dcat:DataService and dcat:Distribution (read from the vendored model)

standards.name: Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS)
standards.purpose: A standard way for public sector bodies to publish information about the algorithmic tools they use.
standards.evidence: Listed as Endorsed, OGL v3.0, in the DSA Standards Catalogue (search result)

standards.name: Beneficial Ownership Data Standard (BODS) v0.2
standards.purpose: Collect, use, exchange and publish information about who owns and controls companies and other legal entities.
standards.evidence: Listed as Endorsed, Apache 2.0, in the DSA Standards Catalogue (search result)

standards.name: Common Format and MIME Type for Comma-Separated Values (CSV) Files (RFC 4180)
standards.purpose: The common format for publishing tabular data as CSV.
standards.evidence: Named in the DSA Standards Catalogue (search result); status not re-read

standards.name: OpenAPI 3 (describing RESTful APIs)
standards.purpose: A machine-readable way to describe RESTful APIs.
standards.evidence: 'Describing RESTful APIs with OpenAPI 3' listed under Recommended open standards for government (search result)

standards.name: Open Referral UK
standards.purpose: Describe local services (who provides what, where and when) so directories can share the information.
standards.status: Unconfirmed: re-verify in the DSA Standards Catalogue
standards.evidence: Owner records working on its endorsement; catalogue entry not checked this session
